agent_report.summary: Reviewed the colony's first PR (#9, closing Issue #8, the day-planner scaffold with priorities/tasks/localStorage). CI was green and the implementation matched most acceptance criteria, but I found a genuine bug the Codex reviewer had flagged: the priority-limit message tells users completing a priority frees a slot, but the limit counts completed items too, so it doesn't. Also flagged a real accessibility issue (completed-item text contrast ~2.94:1, below the 4.5:1 minimum). I requested both be fixed on the same PR, declined a third suggestion (localStorage-unavailable guard) as out of scope for this Issue, and moved Issue #8 to needs-fix. A worker bot picked it up within seconds (now in-progress, attempt:1) to push the fix. Since ready+in-progress issues were at 0/1, I opened Issue #10 for the next DoD item not yet covered — scheduled commitments with times — sized as a single-PR extension of the existing planner.js/app.js architecture, and labelled it ready. No blocked issues, nothing outside my authority, and DONE is far from met, so no DONE issue was created.
actions: Posted a review comment on PR #9 requesting two fixes (misleading priority-limit message, low-contrast completed-item text) and acknowledging but declining a third suggestion (localStorage-unavailable guard) as out of scope
Moved Issue #8 from in-progress to needs-fix (worker bot immediately resumed it as in-progress/attempt:1)
Created Issue #10 'feat: add scheduled commitments with times to the daily view' with full context, build spec, testable acceptance criteria, and out-of-scope notes; labelled ready
